record.context_brief: positive bisectional curvature on total spaces of holomorphic bundles
record.original_question: For which holomorphic vector bundles over a complex manifold M does the total space admit a complete Kähler or Hermitian metric of positive bisectional curvature? In particular, what conditions, possibly including a stability condition on the bundle, are needed?

evidence.quote: Question 4.14. When does the total space of a holomorphic vector bundle over M admit a complete Kähler/Hermitian metric of positive bisectional curvature ? This is not studied even in the case when the base manifold is a Hermitian symmetric space. Also, we might need certain stability condition on the vector bundle.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a complex manifold and let $E \to M$ be a holomorphic vector bundle of rank $r \geq 1$. The total space of $E$ is a complex manifold of dimension $\dim_{\mathbb{C}} M + r$. A Hermitian metric $g$ on a complex manifold $X$ is said to have positive holomorphic bisectional curvature if for every point $x \in X$ and every pair of nonzero $(1,0)$-tangent vectors $u, v \in T_x^{1,0} X$, the bisectional curvature
$$ R(u, \bar u, v, \bar v) > 0. $$
The metric is Kähler if its associated $(1,1)$-form is closed.

Determine, as completely as possible, the holomorphic vector bundles $E \to M$ whose total space admits a complete Kähler (respectively, Hermitian) metric of positive holomorphic bisectional curvature. In particular:

(a) Give necessary and sufficient conditions on the pair $(M, E)$ for the existence of such a metric on the total space of $E$.

(b) Treat the case in which the base $M$ is a Hermitian symmetric space.

(c) Identify whether a stability condition on the bundle $E$ (for instance, slope stability with respect to a chosen polarization on $M$) must be imposed, and if so, formulate the precise stability hypothesis required.
artifact.category_tag: complex differential geometry, positive bisectional curvature
artifact.status_search_result: The general question appears to remain open. Recent partial results characterize complete Kähler metrics of nonnegative bisectional curvature on total spaces of line bundles over elliptic curves, and study positive holomorphic sectional curvature on certain line bundles (e.g., Hirzebruch manifolds), but no general criterion in terms of the base and a stability condition on the bundle is known. The closely related Greene–Wu–Yau / Yau uniformization conjecture for complete noncompact Kähler manifolds with positive bisectional curvature is also still active.

status_evidence.title: Kähler geometry on total spaces of vector bundles over elliptic curves
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizes complete Kähler metrics with nonnegative bisectional curvature on total spaces of line bundles over an elliptic curve.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial classifications are available, restricted to specific bases (elliptic curves) and line bundles.

status_evidence.title: Complete Kähler metrics with positive holomorphic sectional curvatures on certain line bundles
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs complete Kähler metrics with positive holomorphic sectional curvature on certain line bundles, related to Yau's conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Existence results are known only in special cohomogeneity-one settings, not in general.

status_evidence.title: Hirzebruch manifolds and positive holomorphic sectional curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Studies positive holomorphic sectional curvature on Hirzebruch manifolds (projectivized line bundles).
status_evidence.claim: Total spaces of bundles admitting positive curvature metrics have been examined only in restricted families.
